label: conflict_resolution_type setting (Sync Gateway ISGR/database replication)
type: the per-replication setting choosing how Sync Gateway resolves a write conflict (Sequence Number, Timestamp, or 'custom' - which requires sgw:custom-conflict-resolver to be set). Changing it is an Enterprise-Edition-only operation.
note: Field-for-field identical across configuration-schema-database.md's embedded replications object and configuration-schema-isgr.md's standalone schema - see sgw:inter-sync-gateway-replication's own note for the shared-schema finding this comes from.
